long_biography.plain_text:
Makhmudov moved from Soviet-era translation and foreign-trade work into coal and metals trading after the planned economy dissolved. He then assembled copper-industry assets that became UMMC, a vertically integrated mining and metallurgical group, and served as its president and controlling owner. That business established the core of his fortune; later holdings extended into coal, ports and railway-equipment manufacturing.

His present position is narrower than those historical titles suggest. UMMC announced in 2022 that he was no longer a controlling beneficiary and had left its board. His exact residual UMMC ownership is unresolved, while his Transmashholding interest is documented as non-controlling. The durable picture is therefore of a self-made metals industrialist whose current public role is investment ownership, not verified day-to-day management of either company.
